title: finereli/whatsapp-mcp
body:
A read-only MCP server that lets your AI agent search and read your own WhatsApp messages. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

README 節錄：# whatsapp-mcp Let your AI agent read your WhatsApp messages. This is a small server that runs in your own Cloudflare account. You link your phone to it once, the way you'd link WhatsApp Web, and from then on any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, anything that speaks MCP) can search and read your chats. It can read and search your messages, and remember names you give it for phone numbers. It can't send anything. Ask your agent things like: - "What did Dana say about the flights?" - "Find every message where someone mentioned the lease, across all my chats." - "Summarize what I missed in the family group this week." ## How it works Your phone stays the source of truth. The server is a linked device that your agent talks to. It doesn't stay connected to WhatsApp. When your agent asks for something, and once a day, it connects, collects whatever WhatsApp queued for it since last time, writes that to its own database, and hangs up. Your phone keeps working normally and keeps getting notifications. Your messages live in a SQLite database inside a Durable Object in your Cloudflare account. Nothing goes anywhere else. ## Set it up You need a Cloudflare account on the Workers Paid plan (see the note below), Node 20 or later, and your phone. ```sh git clone https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp cd whatsapp-mcp npm install # 1. title: feder-cr/git-ai
body:
Git designed for AI agents.

README 節錄： Git designed for AI agents. Anthropic built **Scion**, a faster version control system for coding agents, and described it in Redesigning source control: a server-centric system built for hundreds of agents that read, write and land code at the same time. Scion is internal to Anthropic and is not available to the public. So I built **gitai**: an open-source version of that design that anyone can run, and that the community can improve and maintain together. MIT licensed. Vendor neutral: the server never calls a language model, and every AI feature works with any provider, or none. gitai is an independent implementation of the publicly described design. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. --- ## Why Classic Git hosting was built for humans who clone a repository, work for hours and push once. Coding agents work differently: thousands of short-lived tasks, each touching a few files, each wanting to land in seconds, all on the same branches. Full clones, merge queues and client-side history walks become the bottleneck. Scion's answer is to move the work to the server: clients stay online and fetch only what they need, history questions are answered (and cached) by the server, changes land through a compare-and-swap instead of a queue, every update is an entry in a changeset log, and the repository state lives in a consistent database plus object storage so servers scale out. gitai implements these ideas, with normal Git rep

title: chenglou/handwired
body:
Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net.

README 節錄：# Handwired Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net; no training, exact, yet also fully differentiable! ## How It Works A program's made of if-else, loops, and state. Handwired transforms them into matrix multiplication + reglu over floats. For example: ```ts const a = 5 const result = (a > 4) ? 10 : 12 ``` The above can be expressed as basic arithmetic: ```ts const a = 5 // Math.max(0, x) is ReLU. For an integer a, above4 is 1 if a > 4, and 0 otherwise const above4 = Math.max(0, a - 4) - Math.max(0, a - 5) // Both branches compute, and above4 picks one const result = above4 * 10 + (1 - above4) * 12 ``` You can calculate that by hand and see that both arrive at the same result. We then collect the + and * and relu into a giant matmul, and either run it on JS or WebGPU, for fun. Because we basically only use these 2 primitives: - the full program stays differentiable - the weights don't need training since they're written manually - existing gpu techniques, such as fusion, sparsity, reordering, have a great time optimizing such minimal primitives This unlocks lots of funny use-cases, like: - unfreezing the weights and train them (what does that even do? Let's find out!) - attaching a specific frozen program to a generic neural net and train end-to-end (now a nanoGPT can do both Shakespeare and your particular UI?) - achieving GPU-level of parallelism with JS code that was written in a traditional singl

title: openbin-ai/binny
body:
BINNY: an open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, or a local one.

README 節錄： BINNY An open source agent harness for reverse engineering. Plug in any model, point it at a binary, and it works through the code with real tools and hands you a report to review. BINNY is the harness, not the model. It brings the tools (decompiled functions, strings, imports, data, a sealed sandbox, local Ghidra), the playbooks, the triage, investigate, draft loop, the budgets, the checkpoints and the report format. The model is whatever you plug in: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Gemini, Bedrock, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio. BINNY opens one of your OpenBin or OpenAPK projects, or decompiles a file on your disk, and runs that loop against the decompiled code. Every step is a tool call you can watch: it lists functions, reads decompilations, pulls strings, imports and data, runs scripts in a sealed sandbox, and records findings as it goes. The draft lands on the project report for you to check before anything is published. It runs on your own model key, or on a local model. Nothing about your sample goes to us unless you put it in a project. ## Install macOS and Linux: ```sh curl -fsSL https://openbin.ai/install-binny.sh | sh ``` Windows (PowerShell): ```powershell irm https://openbin.ai/install-binny.ps1 | iex ``` Then: ```sh openbin login # once; BINNY reuses the openbin CLI's sign-in binny # pick a project, set a key, go ``` Prebuilt binaries fo

title: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
body: I saw this LinkedIn post from a Meta engineer and it resonated with me: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ali-hamie_im-an-engineer-at-m... > I'm an engineer at Meta and I never felt this uncomfortable doing my job. I'm writing code these days and it all feels like a black box. This new standard of shipping with AI is moving so fast that if we're going to spend our time checking each line of code, it's going to take forever. That means you can end up with systems you've built where you don't truly understand how all the code works. You understand the high level, but not every detail. And maybe this is becoming the new standard. It goes against every instinct of being a software engineer. I'm used to understanding what I'm building. README 節錄： **简体中文** | English # huashu-motion > *「一键直出商业级产品宣传片。」* **让你的agent做动画、作曲，指着画面改。** 跟Claude Code、Codex这些agent说一句「给我的产品做个30秒的发布片」， 它会先读你的产品，给你三个方向挑，写出整支片子，自己写谱配乐， 然后在浏览器里打开一个编辑器等你。哪里不满意，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么，它就只改那一处。 ```sh npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-motion ``` 看效果 · 安装 · 能做什么 · 怎么做到的 · 背后的故事 --- ## 看效果 这篇README里的每一段动画都是huashu-motion做的。上面那段取自它给自己做的53秒发布片，👉 下载完整发布片（MP4，带声音），下面Grok Bot、huashu-design、DeepSeek这几支的完整版也在同一个页面。 ### 指着画面改 按C，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么。评论发过去的时候带着时间点、场景、点中的元素和它在源码里的位置，agent先把那一帧和你点的那一小块截图放大看一眼，再只改那一处，改完回一句人话，预览停在原来的位置刷新。每一版都留着，⌘Z随时撤回；标题、数字、颜色、停留时长这些会变成编辑器右边的输入框，自己改，不用等agent。 （这段里的编辑器和终端是照真实界面重建的，代码细节是示意；评论是真实提过的意见。） ### 先写谱，再拍片 做发布片用的是作曲家模式：agent按节奏单先写一份谱（ABC记谱法，纯文本的乐谱），谱里的标记对齐每个场景，再由三角钢琴、弦乐和鼓组的采样演奏出来（真乐器采样要先跑一次`om samples build`，不跑就用合成音色）；画面上每个东西落地的那一帧，再配一个音效。配乐全部在本机现场生成，不调用任何收费接口。 ### 一天，二十支 16个镜头，来自同一天做的七支片子，按拍子切。 Grok Bot（粉丝自制，非官方）· 30秒：傍晚交代任务，夜里几个agent各干各的，早上7点手机上收到汇报。这段是汇报一张张送往Chief of Staff的那几拍。 huashu-design 3.0 · 一句提示词钉住不动，背后的风格按拍子换 小猫补光灯Pro · 八种补光色，一拍换一种 ### 不依赖Opus：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash也能做 这支22秒的动效片，是把Claude Code背后的模型换成DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（1017版）做的。中间我给了三轮意见（比如加上DeepSeek的鲸鱼logo、删掉几个镜头），带配乐和音效，前后不到半小时，按当时的价格花了1块9毛5（缓存命中率99.4%）。统一的配色、贯穿全片的那颗圆点、卡在124BPM上的配乐，是skill带出来的，我一句都没提过。方法写进了skill，便宜的模型也能拍出像样的片子。 --- ## 安装 ### 方式一：跟你的agent说（推荐） ``` 帮我安装huashu-motion这个skill（github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion），装好后跑一遍demo ``` ### 方式二：一行命令 ```sh npx

body: README 節錄： # Timestral Blog post · Hugging Face collection · License Timestral is a family of time series foundation models for multivariate probabilistic forecasting, with support for past-only and known-future covariates. This repository provides standalone inference for Timestral models. It needs only PyTorch, NumPy, `safetensors` and `huggingface_hub`, and runs on CPU or GPU. > **License:** the code in this repository is licensed under Apache 2.0. The Timestral model weights are released separately on the Hugging Face Hub under a Modified MIT license. See License. ## Highlights At launch, Timestral-209M ranked first among pretrained and zero-shot models on the three main public forecasting benchmarks: - 🥇 **GIFT-Eval**: #1 among pretrained and zero-shot models. - 🥇 **TIME**: #1 across 98 tasks. - 🥇 **fev-bench**: #1 across 100 tasks. All four sizes (5M, 28M, 123M, 209M) sit on the Pareto front of accuracy versus model size. Full results are in the blog post and the model cards on Hugging Face. - **Multivariate**: the variates of a series are forecast jointly. - **Covariates**: past-only, known-future and categorical. - **Probabilistic**: 21 quantiles per time step. - **Long context**: up to 32,768 steps. - **CPU-friendly**: no GPU needed for inference. ## Install ```bash pip install git+https://github.com/mistralai/timestral.git # Python >= 3.10, torch >= 2.4 ``` Or from a clone with uv, using the versions pinned in `uv.lock`: ```bash git clone https://github.com/mis

title: dipa-studio/ios-sweet
body:
iOS 16 userland + XNU on Redmi Note 10 Pro (sweet, SM7150)

README 節錄：# ios-sweet **Apple's iOS 16 running on a Redmi Note 10 Pro.** This project ports Apple's open-source XNU kernel (xnu-8796, the iOS 16 generation) to the Xiaomi Redmi Note 10 Pro (`sweet`, Qualcomm SM7150 / Snapdragon 732G). On top of it runs the **unmodified iOS 16.7.16 (20H392) userland of the iPhone X**: launchd, the system daemons, backboardd, SpringBoard and the stock apps. As of **2026-10-18** the phone boots to the **iOS home screen**. You can unlock it, open Settings, pull down Control Center and the notification center, and use the touchscreen and the hardware buttons. Rendering runs entirely on the CPU; there is no GPU driver. > Experimental bring-up, not a usable phone OS. Many things are missing or stubbed (see below), and Apple's security model is mostly switched off. It installs into the `userdata` partition and so **erases Android's user data**. ## What works | Area | State | | --- | --- | | Boot | Stock Xiaomi bootloader → `fastboot boot` of our shim → XNU. Nothing is flashed to the boot partitions | | CPU | 6 of the 8 cores (the six Cortex-A55s) via PSCI, 16K pages, GICv3 interrupts, timers | | Memory | About 3.95 GiB of the upper DDR bank | | Storage | Own UFS host driver; the iOS root is a journaled HFS+ volume in `userdata`, read/write | | iOS userland | Real iPhone X 16.7.16 root filesystem and shared cache; launchd and the system daemons run | | Display | Kernel IOSurface + IOMobileFra

README 節錄：# mcd-party-planner · 麦当劳聚会 / 团餐组织助手 > 基于 **麦当劳 MCP** 真实能力的 Skill：输入「城市 + 关键词 + 人数 + 预算」， > 输出多套**真实计价**的团餐方案；串联主题活动（派对 / 品鉴会）预约链路； > 结合活动日历与附近门店给出组织时机建议。 > > 参赛作品 —— 麦当劳程序员节创意开发大赛（2026 · 1024 程序员节）。 --- ## 一、项目介绍 组织一次多人麦当劳聚餐，真正麻烦的不是点什么，而是三件事同时算清楚：**附近哪家门店能吃、多少人吃什么组合、总共花多少钱不超预算**。 `mcd-party-planner` 把这三件事交给麦当劳 MCP 的真实数据（共接入 **15 个 Tool**）： | 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | **团餐方案生成** | 查附近营业中门店 → 拉真实菜单 → 按「经济型 / 均衡型 / 丰盛型」组装 → 用 `calculate-price` 真实计价，输出 ≥2 套含「合计 / 人均 / 是否超预算」的可比对方案 | | **主题活动预约** | 自动串联 `派对商品 → 城市 → 门店 → 日期 → 场次` 五级查询，输出可直接下单的载荷；**默认 dry_run，不真实下单** | | **活动日历组织建议** | 活动日历（往期 / 今日 / 未来）× 附近门店交叉，给出组织时机建议，并提示企业团餐助餐服务可用性 | 设计原则：**数据全部实时取自麦当劳 MCP，仓库内不含任何静态菜单或价格快照**；用户输入（城市、关键词、人数、预算）仅存在于运行时内存，不落盘、不外发。 > 调用层内置滑动窗口节流器（默认 300 次/分钟，官方上限 600）与 429 指数退避，批量比对不会触发限流。 --- ## 二、安装方法 ### 1. 申请 MCP Token 访问 麦当劳 MCP 开放平台 → 手机号验证登录 → 右上角「控制台」→「激活」→ 同意服务协议 → 复制 Token。 ### 2. 获取代码 ```bash git clone https://github.com/zcbacxc/mcd-party-planner.git cd mcd-party-planner ``` ### 3. 配置 Token ```bash cp .env.example .env # 编辑 .env，填入：MCD_MCP_TOKEN=你的Token ``` > `.env` 已被 `.gitignore` 排除，**绝不会提交到仓库**。仓库中的 `mcp-config.example.json` 只含环境变量占位符。 ### 4. 在 WorkBuddy 中使用（可选） 本项目主交付形态即 WorkBuddy Skill（见 `skill/SKILL.md`）。按 `mcp-config.example.json` 在 WorkBuddy 的【自定义连接器】中启用 `mcd-mcp` 后，直接用自然语言描述聚餐需求即可。 ### 5. 环境要求 - Python 3.9 及以上，**仅依赖标准库，无需 pip 安装任何包**。 ### 6. 自检 ```bash python -m src.cli selfcheck ``` ```text === 环境自检 ===
